title: Make iPhone PWA layout a first-class contract
summary: The PWA now treats iPhone safe areas, Home-indicator spacing and WebKit layout checks as permanent release requirements rather than one-off fixes.
changes: Stabilises the floating bottom dock above the iPhone Home indicator without shrinking its internal controls, while respecting left and right safe areas.
Hardens Night, Changes, Breaks, Chat, Account and scrolled chrome around iPhone safe areas and prevents WebKit form-focus zoom from disrupting mobile layouts.
Adds a common-iPhone-size regression matrix and runs focused iPhone WebKit browser smoke tests on every pull request before changes can merge.
